propositions: pip-audit gating job fails on every patchset against main due to click 8.2.1 triggering PYSEC-2026-2132 advisory (command injection vulnerability in click.edit())
inspect-ai dependency caps click at <8.2.2 and is present in [eval] extra, preventing lock upgrade to vulnerable-fix version 8.3.3+ via standard resolution
uv constraint-dependencies cannot lift the upstream cap; override-dependencies is the correct tool to replace the requirement and permit click >=8.3.3 resolution
inspect-ai 0.3.251 imports cleanly and executes under click 8.4.2 despite stale version cap, making the override safe and the cap a staleness issue not a real incompatibility
fix applied via [tool.uv] override-dependencies = ["click>=8.3.3"] in pyproject.toml and uv.lock relock to 8.4.2, with removal condition tied to upstream PR UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai#4596
